content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: ( XQL(CSPM-002 S3 Public Access Block Removed Drift) OR XQL(CSPM-002 CloudTrail Logging Disabled Drift) ) AND XQL(CSPM-002 Runtime Control Plane Action Causing Drift) — fuses each posture-drift finding on a CortexSimDriftTarget resource with the CloudTrail control-plane action that caused it (and, when present, the post-drift external bucket access) into a single posture-drift incident that names the drifted resource, the responsible principal, and the exploitation window.
rules.name: Posture Drift Correlated to Runtime Cause and Exploitation
